errors.noStorage: Your browser is not letting this game save. You can still play, but your progress will not be kept when you close the page.
errors.saveFailed: Sorry, something went wrong saving your explorer. Please try again.
errors.corruptBody: This explorer's saved data can't be read. A grown-up can fix this in the Parent Area by resetting the explorer.

splash.tagline: Explore islands. Solve puzzles. Find the treasure!
splash.soundNote: Tap to start. This game has sound and a talking parrot.

profiles.title: Who is exploring today?
profiles.resume: Welcome back! Let's finish your level.
profiles.limitBody: Up to {max} explorers can share this device. A grown-up can remove or reset one in the Parent Area to make room.

setup.title: Create your explorer
setup.nickHelp: Use a nickname, not your real name.

map.title: Treasure Map
map.lockedHint: Finish all 10 levels of {prev} to open this world.
map.lockedFinal: Finish Ancient Temple and collect all four map pieces to reach Treasure Island.

explore.find: Look around! Tap the glowing thing to find your challenge.
explore.found: You found it! Here comes the challenge...
explore.clueAria: Glowing clue. Tap to start the challenge

play.exitBody: You will lose your place in this level, but everything you have earned so far is safe.

ending.title: You found the treasure!
ending.body: You explored every world and solved every puzzle. You can replay any level to earn more stars.

camp.title: Explorer Camp
camp.rareNote: Gem items are rare. You win gems by finishing worlds and earning awards.
camp.full: Your camp is full. Remove something first (max {max}).
camp.needMore: You need a few more to buy that.

settings.title: Settings
settings.voiceHelp: Kiki talks and questions can be read to you.
settings.parentNote: Grown-ups can find more options in the Parent Area.

gate.title: Grown-ups only
gate.help: Press and hold the button for two seconds, then answer one question.
gate.wrong: That was not right. Try this new one.

dash.title: Parent Area
dash.intro: Everything here is stored only on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
dash.bad: This explorer's saved data can't be read. Please reset the explorer.
dash.resetOneBody: This erases levels, stars, coins, gems and awards for this explorer. It cannot be undone.
dash.removeBody: This deletes the explorer and all of their progress, and frees up a place for another explorer.
dash.analyticsHelp: Sends anonymous, cookie-free counts such as levels completed. No names or device details. Switch off any time.
dash.analyticsOff: Usage counts are not turned on for this game.
dash.eraseAll: Erase all game data on this device
dash.eraseBody: This deletes every explorer and all saved data in this browser. It cannot be undone.

games.mapAria: A small map. North is at the top.
games.yourTurn: Your turn! Tap the same order.
games.mazeAria: Maze. Use the arrow buttons or arrow keys to move.
games.compassAria: Compass map. Tap where you end up.

word-builder.name: Word Builder
word-builder.how: Tap the letters in order to build the word.

memory-sequence.name: Memory Sequence
memory-sequence.how: Watch the order, then tap the same order.

pattern-puzzle.name: Pattern Puzzle
pattern-puzzle.how: Work out the pattern and tap the answer.

object-hunt.name: Object Hunt
object-hunt.how: Find and tap the hidden things.

maze-path.name: Maze and Path
maze-path.how: Guide your explorer, or follow the compass directions.

science-choice.name: Science Choice
science-choice.how: Answer the question or put things in order.

spot-difference.name: Spot the Difference
spot-difference.how: Tap what is different in the second picture.
